customFields.title: Custom Fields
customFields.description: Define runtime typed fields on core entities without a code change or migration.
customFields.managedBy.notice: Definitions for this entity type are managed by another module and are read-only here.

customFields.audience.help: Internal values are shown to administrators only. Customer-visible values are also returned to the customer in the storefront and to integrations that use the external API. New fields are internal unless you choose otherwise.
